title: Slow product search for EU users after Redis memory limit reduced
summary: During a maintenance window the EU Redis search cache memory limit was lowered from 16GB to 2GB, collapsing the hit rate and overloading Elasticsearch. EU users saw 8-10s search latency for about 70 minutes; category browsing still worked. Restoring the limit resolved it.
severityRationale: Search was degraded for a subset of users (mostly EU) and category browsing was a usable workaround.
impact: Product search took 8-10s per query for mostly EU users from about 09:40 to 10:50 UTC.
detection: Customer support tickets about slow search; Elasticsearch CPU alert fired later at 10:05.

timeline.description: Maintenance window; EU Redis maxmemory changed to 2GB
Support began receiving tickets about slow search
Cache hit rate above 90%, latency normal

rootCauses: EU Redis cache maxmemory was reduced from 16GB to 2GB during maintenance, causing heavy eviction
contributingFactors: No alert on cache hit rate
Redis maintenance changes bypassed change review
resolution: Restored the Redis memory limit to 16GB; hit rate and latency recovered by 10:50.

actionItems.description: Add an alert on search cache hit rate
Route Redis maintenance changes through change review

openQuestions: What share of users were affected outside the EU?
